instrument: Misty Hollow Energy & Data Campus preliminary plan (614 Prospect Rd)
summary: Preliminary plan for about 1 million sq ft of data center on about 274 acres, with an 80,000 sq ft wastewater treatment facility and a 300 MW on-site power generation facility on about 10 acres; before the Planning Commission Sept 24, 2026.
notes: 300 MW is generation capacity, not IT load; no load, GC or tenant confirmed. Developer targets final approvals early 2027, completion mid-2029; township engineer Gannett Fleming reviewing. Closed-loop cooling is a developer claim.
confidence_note: Plan packet, PA DEP air plan approval and NPDES permit not read.
